changelog: Added a crash screen: a crash now shows the report with a copy button instead of the app vanishing
Mermaid diagrams and interactive apps in chat stay alive while the chat is open, and a dead WebView renderer no longer crashes the app
Rootfs backup is verified before it is saved, so every .zip in the backups folder is complete and restorable
Added a switch to include SSH keys and sign-ins in the rootfs backup
The editor now opens files up to 5 MB
